review: I am going to rate this five stars and then ask you something, and I would like you to understand that the second part is not a complaint about the first. My six-year-old sings "No Fear in Here" in the bath. It fixed a real problem in my house that I could not fix by talking. Five stars, honestly given. Now: I went looking for who wrote it. I clicked the artist. I clicked the album. I read the page. There is no writer, no producer, no session player, no photograph, no bio — nothing on this site indicates that a human being was involved at any point. I test software for a living, so I notice absences. I am not accusing you of anything. I am telling you that a parent went looking for the person behind the song his daughter sings every night, found no one, and has not been able to stop thinking about it since. Tell me plainly how this music is made and I will very likely keep paying you. Do not tell me and I will assume, and my assumption will not be generous.
